How to Counter Phishing Attacks?

Posted by u/cyber_guardian99

Phishing attacks are becoming increasingly sophisticated. What are the best practices to identify and prevent them? Looking for practical advice from the community.

Replies

Reply by u/sec_expert_42
Always verify the sender's email address carefully. Phishers often use domains that look similar to legitimate ones (e.g., paypa1.com instead of paypal.com). Enable multi-factor authentication (MFA) on all accounts to add an extra layer of security.

Reply by u/netwatch_pro
Use a reputable email filtering service and keep your browser and security software updated. Be cautious of urgent requests asking for personal information or login credentials.

Reply by u/privacy_hawk
Never click on links in unsolicited emails. Instead, go directly to the website by typing the URL in your browser. Also, look for HTTPS in the URL bar before entering any sensitive information.
